title: Cold finished children: restore failure_detail_version with the terminal flag, and repair a durable "Running" card left by a kill inside a persist deferral window
outcome: Cold finished children: restore failure_detail_version with the terminal flag, and repair a durable "Running" card left by a kill inside a persist deferral window
acceptance: A cold finished child whose stored terminal card is a failed, still-indexed run records failure_detail_version together with the terminal flag, so a rescan does not re-read the failure excerpt; a behavioural test counts the excerpt reads across two scans.

After a restart in which a child's terminal flag was committed but its transcript row was deferred, the child's card does not stay Running: a behavioural test simulates that durable state and asserts the card is terminal after boot and the first scan.
The comment at persisted_state.rs:651-655 describes the actual behaviour; the full gate passes on the exact committed tree with a clean independent review pair.
